evidence: Homepage lists 6 templates, each card shows name (e.g. "Professional Resume"), author (Sarah Chen), description, category/scenario tags, uses count, update date.
Each card shows template name (heading), author, description, type tag (e.g. Resume/Business), and "Updated 2024-12-01" date.
Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume opens a modal dialog with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs specific to that template.
All 13 form fields filled successfully; values persisted in fields.
Preview Result tab shows rendered resume with Name, Title, Email, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills sections populated from form data.

Preview content (Jane Smith, Software Engineer, Tech Corp — Senior Developer, Jan 2020 - Present, B.S. Computer Science — MIT 2018, Skills) exactly matches entered form values, rendered with correct Markdown heading/paragraph structure.
Preview renders proper headings (h1/h2/h3), bold/emphasis, and separator without formatting errors.

Before filling required fields, "Preview Result" tab was disabled and a warning "Required fields missing" listed all missing fields. After filling all required fields, the tab became enabled and clickable.

A visible warning banner (icon + red/amber styled text) "Required fields missing: Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, ..." appeared while required fields were empty, and disappeared once fields were filled.
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" shows toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."

issue: Special characters not restricted in form inputs
actual: Typing "￥#@%^*" into the Full Name field was accepted verbatim (field shows "￥#@%^*Jane Smith"); no filtering occurred and no "Special characters are prohibited" message appeared.

issue: No visual feedback when entering special characters
actual: No warning, error styling, or message appeared after typing special characters (￥#@%^*) into the Full Name field; input was silently accepted.

Date fields (e.g. "Date" in Project Proposal, "Start Date"/"End Date" in Resume) are free-text inputs with no format validation; entering an invalid date "32/13/2020" was accepted with no error message.

issue: No validation that start date precedes end date
actual: Entered Start Date "Dec 2025" and End Date "Jan 2020" (start after end); no error was shown and the Preview Result tab became enabled without restriction, allowing an invalid date range.

issue: Clicking a search suggestion does not redirect to the template
actual: Typing keywords (e.g. "meet") shows a real-time suggestion dropdown (template names and matching field names like "Meeting Title"). However, clicking a suggestion only inserts the suggestion text into the search box and filters the list, it does not open/navigate to the corresponding template's fill-in modal.

evidence: Typing "meet" immediately updated results to "Showing 1 of 6 templates" showing only Meeting Minutes, without needing to submit the search.

Search box shows a suggestion widget/dropdown with fuzzy-matched results (template names and related field names) as user types, e.g. "meet" -> Meeting Minutes, Meeting Title, Next Meeting Date, Next Meeting Topics.
Clicking the heart icon on a template card favorites it; the header "Favorites" button shows a count badge (Favorites 1); clicking it toggles a filtered view showing only favorited templates.
With Favorites filter active, list showed "Showing 1 of 6 templates" (only the favorited Professional Resume); search box could further filter within that view.
Clicking the favorite/heart icon on a card immediately updated the heart button to an active state and incremented the "Favorites" counter badge in the header from 0 to 1.

Category filter (e.g. "Resume") correctly narrowed to 1/6 templates; Scenario filter ("Academic") correctly narrowed to 1/6; Sort By "Most Popular" ordered descending by use count, "Recently Updated" correctly reordered cards by update date descending (2024-12-05, 12-01, 11-28, 11-15, 10-20, 09-30).
Clicking "Submit Template" with empty Title, Author, Description, and Content fields produced a toast "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and did not submit.

Filled Submit Template form (Title, Author, Description, Category, Scenario, Markdown Content with {{fieldName}} syntax, and a custom field) and clicked Submit; a toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library." appeared.

Immediately after submission, the template list updated to "Showing 7 of 7 templates" including a new "QA Test Template" card with author "QA Tester", description, category tag, "0 uses", and "Updated 2026-09-02".
The template library list count and grid updated instantly (6->7) upon submission without requiring a page reload, and the new template appeared at the top of the "Recently Updated" sort.

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submit; malformed content causes rendering errors
actual: Submitted a template with deliberately malformed Markdown (unclosed link "[link text(missing paren", unclosed code fence, unclosed bold "**bold never closed"). The submission succeeded with no validation warning. In preview, the content rendered incorrectly: the heading literally showed "Unclosed [link text(missing paren" (link not parsed) and the unclosed code fence swallowed the remaining text including the unclosed bold marker into a single <code> block, producing a rendering error/garbled output rather than being caught or corrected.
